recipe.audit: independent raw G/dense VJP; exact mask validation; saved applied G drives exact full-Adam replay; all scores and supplemental guards
recipe.controls: audited original first-pass mixed, frozen-core mixed and fitted-prior GRU endpoints; no new comparator run
recipe.first_batch_parity: query0 inputs/targets/all traces/full raw G byte-exact versus saved core query0 before first commit; guard counters intentionally differ
recipe.forward: unchanged full-D dynamic selector; existing guarded wrapper whole-model dense fallback; no two-column fast path
recipe.freezing_rule: preserve raw G; set only applied MP/MB G to +0; zero initial moments keep exact frozen weights/moments; counters advance
recipe.initial_scores: new candidate traces byte-equal bound ORIGINAL initial traces; no original-model forward
recipe.initialization: exact original fitted mixed state0 plus canonical alternate MP=-.01, genuinely empty Adam
recipe.intervention: one true-bank seeded-successor alternate per MP row; primary zero, others unchanged sentinel; full MP/MB frozen
recipe.loss: exact mean CE over full batch in dimensionless units; no second beta
recipe.optimizer: unchanged eager Adam .9/.999 eps1e-8, zero decay, no foreach/fused/clipping
recipe.quality_gate: none; one fixed map/margin/order/budget, no global capacity or hardware claim
recipe.route_scope: exhaustive primary/alternate/other and BOTH-choice rows at EACH checkpoint; head and temporal changes separate; activation not a quality gate

route_scope: query BOTH counts are row-checkpoints; final cohorts are separate fixed checkpoints; cross-recipe final differences are not within-trajectory stability or gradient mass
scope: single original-start fixed two-candidate routing control; activation is descriptive, not a quality gate; no global capacity or hardware claim

transform.scope: initial tied-bank construction only; actual parity must be checked; unchanged full-D selector
